Here is the process:

Select Sprig

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Select Project:

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Select Directory

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Select Bult Add from CO. Directory

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Click on Select pull down menu.  Input the individual’s name.  Click on the name.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Since Flores is already added, I am showing you adding Nick Gairaud so that you can see.

Permission Template is auto-populated.  For Flores, it was already selected as a Superintendent.  Project roll, select Superintendent.  Check the Notify box.  Then click ad to project:

![](data:image/png;base64,)

This is the extent of what we do.  Hopefully this helps.
